translations.text: He is fearsome and renowned, and his judgment will come from himself, and his dignity will proceed from himself.
Destruction will come upon the ungodly who have turned to confront them face-to-face; he will gather captives like sand.
For the vision is still for an appointed time, and it will dawn at the end, and not in vain. But if he delays, wait for him, for the one who is to come will come and will not delay.
And if anyone wavers, my soul will take no pleasure in him, for the righteous person will live by faith.
